_comment: Tier-2: the python-layer LinearStrainEnergyResponseFunction needs the full OptimizationProblem + ExecutionPolicyDecorator stack, whereas the compiled statics under KOA.ResponseUtils give the same values directly on a programmatic ModelPart. Pitfall (kratos.optimization #5). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Both LinearStrainEnergyResponseUtils and MassResponseUtils resolve under KOA.ResponseUtils and NOT as top-level KOA attributes — the nesting is the part a reader gets wrong, and dotting the flat name raises AttributeError before the analysis-stage machinery is ever reached. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX RENUMBERED 5 -> 4: guidance entries were moved out of kratos.optimization's pitfalls list, which shifted the indices of the entries after them. The claim this fixture verifies is unchanged.
